name: Victor
source:
A young man who supports the Demon Queen's army as the Demon Queen's right-hand man. The protagonist of this work. In order to fight against the angels, he was ordered by the Demon Queen to "discipline" Elsha, Sophie, and Ulrika so that they could exercise their powers correctly.
Believes that all women are like beautiful flowers, but he is particularly fond of women with plump breasts like the Demon Queen.

Likes: Demon queen, voluptuous breasts, beautiful things & ways of life
Dislikes: Giving up, things that aren't beautiful
Hobbies: Female observation
